title: Bob's dual special bit equals Alice's original
statement: Let $\omega$ be a sample of the hard distribution, and let $\omega'$ be its dual, obtained by exchanging the roles of Alice and Bob and reversing the order of the coordinates. Then Bob's bit at the special coordinate of $\omega'$ equals Alice's bit at the special coordinate of $\omega$.
hypotheses_covered: its dual sample $\omega'$ (Alice/Bob swapped, coordinates reversed)
replaced: Bob's special bit in the dual hard sample is Alice's original special bit.
